statement: If the compact local exterior is the EH Schwarzschild or Schwarzschild-de Sitter family and the PPN readout uses the observed isotropic weak-field coordinate, then beta=1.
math_form: g00=-1+2 mu/(c^2 rho)-2 mu^2/(c^4 rho^2)+O(c^-6); U=mu/rho => beta_eff=1
requires: EH-only exterior; static/spherical or equivalent monopole/no-hair theorem; same observed metric/readout; local Lambda/tidal subtraction

statement: For any first-order source amplitude A, if the nonlinear exterior metric is generated by the same mass parameter mu=A W rho, the quadratic coefficient is B=A^2.
requires: one mass parameter controls both U and U^2 terms; no extra quadratic source, R11, q_loc, boundary, or readout term

statement: The EH mass parameter must be the measured orbital GM after source calibration, not merely a formal integration constant.
math_form: mu_EH = mu_obs = G0 M_H and partial_{t,r,A,lambda,frame} mu_obs=0
requires: 523 chain passes; charge-current identity; Gauss surface equality; orbital readout; zero mu_extra; constant G_eff

statement: Local Lambda/tidal/background terms must be subtracted or shown not to contaminate the beta U^2 coefficient.
math_form: g00 includes background terms O(Lambda rho^2) or tidal pieces, which are not beta U^2 and require separate local-background handling
requires: local background subtraction or bound; no preferred-location xi leakage

statement: If the EH mass-family premises fail, beta remains a component residual.
requires: componentwise fill rows and no-cancellation beta envelope
